findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_events, get_seating_map, compare_prices, find_ticket_groups, best_seats, section_info, artist_tours · Private data: find_events, report_fact · Public sink: report_fact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_events, get_seating_map, compare_prices, find_ticket_groups, best_seats, section_info, artist_tours · Private data: find_events, report_fact · Public sink: report_fact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
